'''Tech''' was a branch of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[Analysis Bureau (Imperial Intelligence)|Analysis Bureau]]. Their mandate had two main objectives; to analyze enemy technology and determine how it functioned, and to supply Intelligence with hardware to counter it. Tech was full of brilliant and skilled [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] and technologists who used the branch's generous budget to supply Intelligence agents with superior technology. The administration, drawn from the ranks of the branch, however, were unable to properly decide on research priorities that lay outside their field of expertise. Tech was better at analysing enemy equipment than they were at producing it.<ref name="ISB" /> Tech maintained [[Technical Branch Outpost]]s on several [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Lotide]] and [[Dakot Seven]].<ref name="BI">[[Black Ice (adventure)|''Black Ice'']]</ref>

Tech's personnel including [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tobias]], who advocated for the use of [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]] as infiltration units,<ref name="ISB" /> [[Alessi Quon]], the [[Sluissi]] creator of [[IN-GA 44]], and [[Royd Pew]].<ref name="AoE1" />
